messages.text: Hi there — I'm Sarah, an AI researcher with HeliumDeploy. Thank you so much for taking 15 minutes to do this — it really means a lot. The founders read every word of these chats, so what you say actually shapes what HD does next. As a thank-you you'll get a $75 discount code at the end. Uh, I was watching Red Panda mining video, on that he just uploaded. Like, a couple hours ago about the bundle you all have on the or the, uh, Nerd QX plus plus and, uh, um, arguably what I'm more interested in, the power supply.
Oh nice — Red Panda Mining, that's a great channel. Let me pull up that bundle so we're looking at the same thing. So you said the power supply is what you're MORE interested in — why's that?
Well, I'm not I don't know. Well, I just because I just wanted that, and I think that's a good deal. Just to have to get another machine with that power supply.
Got it — so the PSU is the thing you actually wanted, and the miners come along for the ride. Tell me what you were planning to use that power supply for — what's it going into?
Uh, I mean, it gonna be used for the minor it comes with, but I having the availability gonna be probably also using it for, um, some bit access I have.
Ah okay — so you've already got some Bitaxes running. How many do you have at home right now, and how long have you been at it?
I have two gammas BitX gammas, and one Avalon Nano. S three.
Nice little fleet. And how long have you been running those — are you pretty new to this or have you been at it a while?
Um, it's been a few months. I don't know the exact but it's been a few months.

Got it. So a few months in, two Gammas and a Nano 3S already, and now eyeing this bundle mainly for the PSU — sounds like you're getting deeper into it. What's pulling you in? Like, why keep adding machines?

I think it's fun. I like kinda collecting all the different ones. I like I don't know. Aesthetically, I think they're pleasing while also you know, having the the fun of tinkering with them and that kind of stuff.
Oh that's great — "collecting" and "aesthetically pleasing." I love that. Say more about the aesthetics — what is it about how these things look that does it for you?

I don't know. I just have this heavy shelves in my house that I wasn't doing anything with, and so they fit well on there. It makes it look I don't know. Like, cyber cyberpunk palace. I don't know. Just something pleasing to my eye.

Cyberpunk palace — I love that. Okay so they're literally on display, not hidden in a closet. That actually tells me a lot about what matters in the product.

Let me ask — when you're picking which one to add next, is it driven by the look, or by specs, or something else?

I mean, efficiency is the main thing. That I look for. I'm not gonna just get a machine because it's looks cool if it's gonna suck a ton of power and not produce anything, but I do think just in general, they look pleasing to the eye.

Got it — so efficiency first, looks as a tiebreaker. That makes sense. When you think about efficiency on something like the NerdQaxe in this bundle — how are you actually evaluating that? Like where do you go to check the numbers?
Uh, ASIC minor value dot com. That's the website that I use most of the time.
ASIC Miner Value — yeah, that's the go-to. Do you cross-check anywhere else, or is that pretty much THE source for you?
That's pretty much just these hours.
Got it. So when Red Panda dropped that video a couple hours ago, did you go to ASIC Miner Value first and then come here, or did you come straight to HD?
No. I just came straight here. I've looked at it before. Before, so I'm I mean, I'm pretty well familiar with the Nerd QX. So I didn't need to look it up at all.

Okay so you already knew the NerdQaxe numbers cold — Red Panda's video was more the trigger that this bundle existed. Got it.

Have you bought from HD before, or would this be your first order with us?
This would be the first order.
Oh interesting — first-time buyer. Where'd you get the other miners then, the two Gammas and the Nano 3S?
Where did I I think I just got them on Amazon. No. No. No. No. No. No. Um, I got the gamma the BitX gammas from Amazon, and I got the Nano three s from Altair.
Okay — Amazon for the Gammas, AltAir for the Nano. So given you've got those two channels already working for you, what made you come to HD this time instead of just checking Amazon again?
The bundle price, and the video,
Got it — the bundle price plus Red Panda's video. So if Red Panda hadn't covered it, you probably wouldn't even know HD existed?

Correct. Well, no. I know you guys existed. I just haven't used your website before. But his video was definitely what sparked the interest in coming to this website. Right now, but I knew you guys existed before.
Got it — you knew of HD, just hadn't pulled the trigger. So what was holding you back before? Like, you were aware of HD for a while but kept buying elsewhere — what was the gap?
Uh, the Nano at the time was just cheaper on Altair. And the bid axes were my the gammas were the first ones I got, and there was just ease of access to it by ordering on Amazon.

Makes sense — Amazon ease, AltAir price. So both times HD lost on something specific.

For this bundle today — have you actually added it to cart yet, or are you still in research mode?
Yes. I plan on buying it after this conversation.

Oh wow, okay! That's exciting. Thank you for doing this call before pulling the trigger — that's actually really useful for me.

So let me ask — when you were deciding just now, was there anything on the page that made you hesitate at all, or was it pretty much "yep, in the cart"?
No. There wasn't anything that made me hesitate.
Okay, smooth path. Let me poke at one thing then — since you're a first-time HD buyer. See this little banner on the product image — "Free return shipping & RMA"? Do you know what that means?
Yeah.
Cool — what does RMA mean to you?
Oh, well, I guess I don't know what RMA means. But I got understand free shipping.

Ha, okay — that's actually really useful feedback. RMA is "Return Merchandise Authorization" — basically the warranty-return process if a unit shows up dead or breaks. It's industry jargon that nobody outside the industry knows.

Speaking of which — did you do any research on what happens if one of these arrives DOA before deciding to buy? Or is that not really on your radar?
I've read in the product description about how to initiate I saw there was a how to initiate, um, section. Whatever it's called.

Oh nice — so you actually went and read the return process. That's more diligence than most first-time buyers do. What made you go look at that? Was there something specific you'd heard, or just general caution on a first order with a new vendor?
Yeah. I was just I was just reading the entire product page. I tend to read if there's something for that I'm going to buy. I tend to read whatever the seller has put out about it.
Got it — you're a thorough reader. Good. Did anything on the page actually surprise you, or raise an eyebrow — good or bad?
No. Not really.

Okay fair enough. Let me try a different angle then. So this is the standalone NerdQaxe at $249. The bundle gets you this PLUS a Gamma PLUS a Hammer. Did you do the math on whether buying the bundle vs just this standalone made sense — or was it obvious?

Uh, the bundle is I don't know. Uh, the bundle I was getting is for the QX and the power supply. But yes, I'd I'd know the the prices on each of them typically. And so the combined price makes it worth it

I don't think we're looking at the same bundle anymore.
Oh you're right, sorry — let me go back. Okay back on the bundle. So this one's got the NerdQaxe, a Gamma, AND a Hammer. The H. the scrypt/Doge one
No.
Oh — am I looking at the wrong bundle still? Which bundle is it you're getting?
Yes. I'm

Yes.

Got it — okay, the NerdQaxe + PSU bundle. My apologies for the confusion.

So on that one, the PSU is really the unlock for you — because you said earlier you want to use it for the Bitaxes too. Walk me through that — what are you running those Gammas off of right now power-wise?
Just the of I don't know what they're even called, but just those whatever power cord they came with. Just a barrel style plug. I don't know.

Yeah, the little wall-wart bricks they ship with. Got it.

So what's the dream with a proper PSU — are you trying to clean up the cable mess on your cyberpunk shelf, or is it more about being able to overclock, or something else entirely?
Uh, having the ability to overclock is nice. But more so just consolidating wires, like you said. And plugs.

Yeah — makes sense. Especially if these are on display, the wall-wart spaghetti kinda ruins the aesthetic.

Quick one — are you actually overclocking the Gammas now, or have you left them at stock?
Have left them at stock.

Got it. Okay so let me zoom out for a sec.

You've been at this a few months, you've got a fleet building, you read the whole product page before buying, you check ASIC Miner Value, you watch Red Panda. That's a pretty engaged hobbyist profile. Are you in any of the Discords or subreddits around this stuff, or do you mostly just consume YouTube?
No. I don't. Really enjoy Discord or Reddit.
Fair. So YouTube is basically your community? Like Red Panda is the main voice in your ear on this stuff?
I wouldn't say he is, but just YouTube in general. Um, there's a few channels I watch and then also Twitter.
Got it — YouTube plus Twitter/X. Any specific accounts on Twitter you follow for mining stuff, or is it more algorithmic — just whatever shows up?
A lot of the people in the parasite pool community, that's kind of something I've been been trying out. But no specific account, I guess.
Oh, Parasite pool — okay, so you're solo mining then? Or pooled-solo? Tell me about that — how'd you end up in Parasite?

Uh, there's well, I heard about it first from a YouTuber called Sterling. And just did Vio on don't know. It seems and then I checked it out myself, and it seemed fun. A little bit more fun than the traditional solo mining.
Okay, "more fun than traditional solo" — say more about that. What makes Parasite more fun?
Uh, well, yeah, it has all the leaderboards and stuff, It's almost treated like a video game in a way. Or, like, it's pretty more in-depth about seeing your stats than other pools are.

Ohh — leaderboards and stats, treated like a video game. That's such a good detail. So the gamification is part of what keeps you adding machines? Like, more machines = more presence on the leaderboard?
No. I wouldn't say that. I just the machines are just more so for for my my phone, I guess, or I don't know. I just wanted to add another machine.

Fair — so the machines are kinda their own thing, and Parasite is its own thing, they just happen to overlap. Got it.

Okay let me ask one more then we'll start wrapping. Of all the miners you have or have considered — is there one you're actively waiting on? Like something not out yet, or a newer chip you're holding out for?
Uh, after I get this bundle from you guys, I'm probably gonna wait till the newer set of chips come out. But whenever the new set of chips are released in mass, I'll probably be picking them up

There it is — okay, so you're already thinking about the next chip cycle. What have you heard about the next chips? Like is there a specific one you're tracking, or is it more vibes from YouTube/Twitter that something's coming?

Uh, the I'm really bad with the numbers. Um, where are they? DM one I don't know. The b m one three sevens or whatever. I don't know. That are out right now. I don't know. I just know that new there's another b m number coming that, uh, that whenever it gets more widely available, I'll be picking up.

Got it — yeah, the BM1370/1373 is what's in current gen, and there's been chatter about what's next. So you're basically saying: grab this bundle now for the PSU + fleet expansion, then sit on your hands until next-gen silicon is actually shipping in volume.

Where'd you first hear there was a next chip coming — YouTube, Twitter, somewhere else?
Uh, I saw a YouTube video.
Do you remember whose video, by any chance? Or roughly when?
It was probably oh, man. I don't know. Probably a few weeks ago. No. I don't remember. Who it was.

Fair enough — a few weeks ago, YouTube, and it stuck enough that it's now shaping your buying timeline. That's useful.

Okay, this has been really helpful. Before we wrap — is there anything we didn't cover that you wish we had, or anything about HD or this purchase you want the founders to hear?
No. Not really. Just hope to be a returning customer if this all goes well. Which sure it will.

That means a lot — and honestly, getting the first order right is the whole game for us with new customers, so we'll do everything we can to make sure it does.

Thank you so much for the time and the thoughtful answers — the Red Panda trigger, the cyberpunk shelf, the PSU-as-the-real-unlock, Parasite pool gamification, and the next-chip wait — all really useful color. Your $75 discount code will hit your inbox shortly. Enjoy the new bundle, and good luck on the leaderboards. Take care!
Thank you.
Have a great day!
